courses.title: Self-Compassion for Caregivers, with Kristin Neff
courses.description: A three-hour live online workshop for family and professional caregivers on why caring only outward leaves us drained and how self-compassion lets us keep going. Neff presents the research and teaches practices for staying balanced in hard caregiving situations.

courses.title: Self-Compassion for Work Stress and Burnout, with Kristin Neff
courses.description: A three-hour live online workshop on how work stress turns into burnout and how tender and fierce self-compassion can ease it. Lecture, discussion and exercises give simple tools to use on the job.
